title: Work from net force
description: Essential: Correctly applies work-energy theorem to find net work on A from 0 to t1 as (1/2)mv1² - (1/2)mv0².

title: Distance at t1
description: Essential: Correctly determines the separation r0 at t1 by balancing forces on A (Coulomb, electric, friction) to get sqrt(kq/E).

title: Total electric field work
description: Essential: Correctly calculates total work by uniform E-field on both A and B from t1 to t2 as (q√(kqE))/2.

title: Final velocity for new condition
description: Essential: Correctly finds A's velocity just before rod collision when v at S is 2v1, as (1+√3)v1.

title: Force balance reasoning
description: Important: Recognizes that at t1 and t2, A's acceleration is zero (max/min speed), enabling force equilibrium equations.

title: Relative motion analysis
description: Important: Applies the condition that after t1, A and B accelerate equally (same Δv) due to the rigid rod/spring connection.

title: Energy conservation setup
description: Optional: Sets up work-energy equations correctly for both sliders, accounting for electric, friction, spring, and Coulomb work.

title: Sign error in forces
description: Pitfall: Misidentifies direction of friction, electric force, or Coulomb force in equilibrium equations, leading to incorrect distance.

title: Confusing net vs. total work
description: Pitfall: For part (1), incorrectly uses total work (all forces) instead of work by net external force, or misapplies theorem.

title: Unit or constant omission
description: Pitfall: Final answers lack necessary constants (k, q, E, m, v1) or have incorrect algebraic structure.
